text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One evening, while passing through the 
shopping district—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Crowd detected at a distance of 18m 54cm 
ahead. That is...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Hot Springs Trip Ticket", "Special Carrot 
Hamburg Steak"... I see.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Actually, right now, I am searching for a 
suitable gift to express my "gratitude" 
toward Master, but—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No, it is only natural. ...However, this 
mission is proving to be far more arduous 
than anticipated—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In other words, the more effective it is, 
the more expensive it gets. As a student, 
I lack the financial means.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, I estimate this lottery could 
yield a sufficiently wonderful gift.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And Mihono Bourbon stared intently at the 
poster detailing the lottery.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Confirming the flowchart for the 
"Raffle." Acquisition of raffle tickets is 
required... I see.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Master. Do you currently require any 
supplies, such as a toothbrush, socks, or 
a handkerchief?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feeling truly bad about it, I sent them 
off to go buy something for themselves 
instead.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Successfully obtained lottery tickets 
through protein purchase. Transitioning to 
Phase 2."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon enthusiastically turned the 
handle of the raffle wheel!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Mission complete. Acquired "Hot Springs 
Trip Voucher."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...While I understand that this occurs 
with a certain probability, I am feeling a 
slight sense of 『astonishment』.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: To think I'd actually win the drawing...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes. Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Well then, allow me to present this to you 
without further delay. I am always 
grateful for you, Master.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...? Yes. The objective of this mission is 
to present the hot spring vacation voucher 
to Master.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Please warm both your body and mind in the 
hot springs.
choice_data_list:
Even so, Bourbon went through the trouble 
of winning it for you...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Confusion detected from Master. Seeking 
resolution protocol.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
――Found one hit. Since it's a pair of 
tickets, I'll accompany you to carry the 
luggage.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
We will explore every possible relaxation 
method to plan an effective hot spring 
trip.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The disadvantage is that it is somewhat 
difficult to put into practice 
immediately, however...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: How about it?
choice_data_list: I-I can't let you do something like that!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I feel like I've managed to avoid 
the outcome where she doesn't use it at 
all.
choice_data_list:
Let's think about it again once things 
settle down after the race.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes, Master.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Regardless of how we'll use it... for now, 
I ended up holding onto the hot spring 
trip ticket!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Mission complete. Acquired 1st prize.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It may not compare to a "Hot Springs Trip 
Ticket"... but it's still a dish packed 
with nutrition.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
And so, here you go. I'm always grateful 
to you, Master.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Kyuu~)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
choice_data_list: Let's eat together, if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: No, well... but...
choice_data_list: It tastes better when we eat together.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...The rationale remains unclear, but if 
it is Master's order, I shall accept it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After getting home, the two of us 
thoroughly enjoyed the "Special Carrot 
Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In the end, it was second place. It's not 
a bad result, but still...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My apologies, Master. These carrots were 
used in my cooking—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And Mihono Bourbon stared at the heaping 
pile of carrots.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: —Status "Inspiration" triggered.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It is possible to create new dishes from 
this large amount of carrots.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In other words... if I use these to craft 
a gift, it's mission complete...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Searching recipes—confirmed diverse uses, 
ranging from kinpira and namul to cakes 
and cookies.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Please be in the trainer's room at 18:00 
today, Master.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That night, a mountain of delicious carrot 
dishes was brought into the Trainer's 
room!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: A carrot, just one...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My apologies, Master. Please allow me to 
express my gratitude at a later date.
choice_data_list:
Your feelings have come through loud and 
clear.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lifting her head, Mihono Bourbon seemed to 
spot something.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"A bag of potatoes for 150 yen... An onion 
for 40 yen...!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Master, may I visit your dorm room around 
18:00 tonight?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Requesting to 
maintain status: 'Hungry'.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That night, Mihono Bourbon visited me 
carrying curry packed into a 
heat-resistant container.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Mission failed. My deepest apologies, 
Master.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I shall express my "gratitude" at a later 
date.
choice_data_list:
Your feelings came through loud and clear, 
so don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: However... Status: 'Regrettable'...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Don't look so down, young lady! Let's do 
this again next time you get a chance!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Mihono Bourbon's shoulders slumped in 
disappointment, we began our journey back.
